# Hammad Tariq

> Personal technical blog of Hammad Tariq, a technical founder building identity and security infrastructure for AI agents (OpenBotAuth, Attach) and HamariHawa, a live map of crop fires and air pollution over Pakistan and India. Posts cover agent identity and authentication, Web Bot Auth and HTTP Message Signatures, agent security, confidential AI inference, and startup strategy.

Site: {{ site.url }}
About the author: {{ '/about/' | absolute_url }}
Contact: @hammadtariq on X, github.com/hammadtq
Last updated: {{ site.time | date: "%Y-%m-%d" }}

## About the Author

Hammad Tariq is a technical founder. His work spans:
- Identity and authentication for AI agents (OpenBotAuth, Web Bot Auth, RFC 9421)
- Security for AI agents and coding assistants (Attach Gateway, attach-guard)
- Air quality and climate data (HamariHawa)
- Earlier work on Ethereum development tools, smart contracts and RAG systems

## Projects

- [HamariHawa](https://hamarihawa.org/): founder. Live satellite map of crop fires, smoke, traffic NO2 and air pollution over Pakistan and India, with health guidance for 58 cities in English, Urdu and Hindi.
- [OpenBotAuth](https://openbotauth.org): open-source reference implementation of Web Bot Auth (docs: https://docs.openbotauth.org/)
- [Attach](https://attach.dev): auth gateway and security tooling for AI agents, including [Attach Gateway](https://github.com/attach-dev/attach-gateway) and [attach-guard](https://attach.dev/attach-guard)
- BitDSM: Bitcoin integration with EigenLayer for institutional staking
- Sakana UI: Perplexity-style deep research tool

## Main Topics

### AI Agents & Infrastructure
- AI agent frameworks and orchestration
- Multi-agent systems for development
- Pre-trained agents for specific roles (PM, researcher, coder)
- Agent-as-a-Service (AaaS) platforms

### Web3 & Ethereum
- Smart contracts for AI infrastructure
- On-chain AI orchestration
- DeFi automation with AI agents
- DAO governance with AI

### Decentralized Identity & Auth
- Web Bot Auth (IETF standards)
- OpenBotAuth reference implementation
- Agent-to-agent authentication
- Delegation and mandate tokens

### AI Security & Privacy
- Confidential AI inference
- Verifiable compute for LLMs
- OIDC + A2A authentication for AI endpoints

### Frameworks & Thinking
- Leveraged Thinking: 4-Layer Framework
- Post-scarcity economics (AI + Crypto)
- PageRank for the agentic web
- Portable keypair identity for agents (OAuth vs keypairs)

## Technical Stack

Languages & Frameworks: Solidity, Python, TypeScript, Go
AI/ML: LLMs (GPT-4, Claude), RAG systems, vector databases (Qdrant, Weaviate)
Blockchain: Ethereum, EigenLayer, L2s (Arbitrum, Optimism, Base)
Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, IPFS
Auth: OIDC, X.509, RFC 9421 HTTP Signatures, A2A protocol
